content.text: : a cognitive state of loss of awareness of self & situation w/ an inability to response to stimuli
: rapid onset, self-limited LOC w/ complete recovery
: prodromal symptoms of syncope (e.g., lightheadedness, N/V, diaphoresis, blurry vision)
: transient, self-limited LOC caused by transient, self-terminating, inadequate nutrient flow to the brain
: neural reflexes inappropriately modify HR & BP
» emotional stress (e.g., fear/pain, sight of blood)
» orthostatic stress (e.g., prolonged standing, usually in a warm environment)
: occurs w/ pressure on carotid sinus d/t carotid sinus hypersensitivity (CSH)
» ⊕ = HR (ventricular) pause ≥3s &/or SBP ⇣ ≥50mmHg when pressure applied
: SBP ⇣ ≥20mmHg or DBP ⇣ ≥10mmHg w/ upright posture
: antidepressants (e.g., TCAs, phenothiazine APs), antihypertensive agents (e.g., β/⍺ blockers,
hydralazine, ACEI), vasodilators (e.g., CCBs, nitrates), opiates, bromocriptine
: inadequate fluid intake, excessive loss (e.g., sweating, hemorrhage), vomiting/diarrhea
: pure autonomic failure, multiple system atrophy, Parkinson
: diabetes, amyloidosis, spinal cord injuries, autoimmune neuropathy (Guillain-Barré)
: tachyarrhythmias (e.g., VTACH, SVT), bradyarrhythmias (e.g., AV block, prolonged sinus pause)
: severe aortic stenosis, HCM, cardiac tamponade, atrial myxoma
: pulmonary embolism, acute MI/ischemia, severe pulmonary HTN, aortic dissection
: detailed H&P, EKG, risk assessment, ECHO if structural heart disease suspected
▪︎Orthostatic	▪︎SXS develop within several minutes of being upright	▪︎clinical +/- tilt table testing
▪︎second degree, Mobitz II						▪︎pre-excited QRS complexes suggesting WPW
▪︎during exertion, when supine, new-onset CP		▪︎family HX of sudden death, CHF, HCM/DCM
▪︎palpitations preceding syncope, associated dyspnea	▪︎LV outflow obstruction, LVEF <35%, CAD/MI
